summary.text: Garlan Gudger, a Republican, has represented Alabama Senate District 4 since November 7, 2018, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: The Alabama State Senate unanimously elected him president pro tempore on February 4, 2025.
Born in Cullman, Alabama, in 1975, he earned a bachelor's degree in building science from Auburn University in 1998 and, as of October 2025, owned Southern Accents Architectural Antiques.
He served on the Cullman City Council for 14 years, beginning with his election in 2004, including 10 years as council president.
